brief:
Drop Site News reported that internal documents reveal Uganda has maintained a years-long Israeli program to enhance its drone capabilities. The disclosure emerges as Uganda prepares to deploy troops to a Gaza "stabilization force," according to the leaked files.

The leaked materials document an extended partnership between Uganda and Israel focused on upgrading Kampala's unmanned aerial systems. The revelations provide the first detailed public evidence of the military cooperation between the two countries. The timing of the document leak coincides with Uganda's announced military mobilization plans for deployment to Gaza.
dek: As Uganda prepares to deploy troops to a Gaza “stabilization force,” internal documents show a years-long Israeli program to upgrade the country’s drone capabilities.
title: Uganda's leaked files expose years of Israeli drone upgrades.
